grades.A: Validated desk pick: the edge is outside noise and held up out of sample.
grades.B: Forward-test desk pick: the model beats the DraftKings close this season, not yet outside noise.
grades.C: Model lean: the favourite the model and DraftKings both favour. Not an edge.
grades.D: No bet: the model's side, shown for information only.
grades.HOLD: On hold: the desk is waiting on a lineup question.

grade_rule: A = validated desk pick (85 + up to 15 for EV). B = forward-test desk pick (65 + up to 15 for EV). C = model lean, the favourite model and DraftKings agree on (40 to 60, by how strongly they agree); not an edge. D = no bet (model side shown for information). HOLD = waiting on a lineup question. Only A, B and C are bets; only they are logged and graded.
